title: Apply Explorer: guided safe-apply wizard, batching/cache suggestions, and audit timeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "Apply Explorer" UX surface in the Optimize console that guides customers through safe configuration changes suggested by batching and caching recommendations. The feature bundles: 1) a compact recommendation card layout with inline cost/latency delta previews and confidence signals; 2) a guided safe-apply wizard that validates config compatibility, shows automated rollback options, and offers canary split targets; and 3) a searchable apply history + audit timeline that ties each change to prompts, eval snapshots, and the runtime metrics that motivated the recommendation. The deliverable must work across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments and respect RBAC and audit logging requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards show estimated token-cost delta, latency impact, and confidence score for batching and cache suggestions
Inline diff preview renders before/after config with highlighted safe-change flags and automated rollback plan
Safe-apply wizard runs validation checks (compatibility, quantization policy, kv cache warmup) and blocks unsafe applies
Canary and quick-rollback flows available (10%, 50%, full) with automatic fallback on regression thresholds
Apply history table shows who applied the change, timestamp, linked PR/drive artifact, and runtime metrics before/after
Audit timeline exposes eval snapshots (prompt sets), automatic regression alerts, and linkage to incident runbooks
UX respects user permissions: only users with 'optimize.apply' can run wizard; audit-only roles can view history
E2E tests for the wizard and apply/rollback flows cover common failure modes and are included in release gating
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Marcus, Priya), Design (Liam), and Security (Sara). Aligned on scope: cards + wizard + history. Agreed to MVP that does not include full sandbox replay for cycle 1.
2026-03-04: Design delivered high-fidelity flows for card states (suggested/accepted/rolled-back) and the guided wizard modal. Design notes: show confidence ribbon + evidence links.
2026-03-06: ENG spike completed: backend needs two new endpoints (recommendation-preview, apply-plan) and one new DB table for apply-revisions. Estimated 3 sprints of ENG work.
2026-03-09: Security flagged KMS dependency for saving rollback keys in Private deployments; created ENG-20111. Decided to gate Private apply until KMS integration is in place.
2026-03-10: PM review with stakeholders. Added requirement to persist eval snapshots to the Optimize evaluation store and link them from the audit timeline.
comments: Design feedback (Liam) 2026-03-04: Recommend adding an 'evidence' flyout showing the exact trace and token distribution that produced the recommendation.
Engineering note (Marcus) 2026-03-06: KV cache warmup can increase initial latency; propose a toggle in wizard to stagger warmup during canary to avoid global p99 regressions.
Security review (Sara) 2026-03-09: Private deployments must not ship rollback state to Redwood-managed S3. Action: add customer-managed storage option.
Customer ops (Rebecca) 2026-03-10: Request retention of apply audit logs for 365 days for enterprise customers. Added as labels and will discuss pricing implications.
PM decision (Aisha) 2026-03-10: MVP will include 90-day audit retention; enterprise upsell for 365-day retention. Added follow-up ticket PM-82712 for retention policy work.
